address: via Tollarini 70/c, località Pontagna di Temù, Ponte di Legno, 25050, Italy
bio: Old stables have been converted into this restaurant, which boasts a stylish decor of wood and stone and the sort of romantic atmosphere that you would expect from the mountains. Although a few fish options are included on the menu, the cuisine focuses mainly on Alpine cuisine, featuring ingredients such as mushrooms, meat and game....
